controles.affirmation: Le 10-Q T2 2026 mentionne des demandes d'informations et des investigations menees par des regulateurs d'Etat en lien avec l'incident de cybersecurite de septembre 2023
controles.verbatim_source: the timing and outcome of investigations by state regulators related to the September 2023 cybersecurity issue (10-Q T2 2026, section Forward-Looking Statements)
controles.correction_proposee: L'expression 'requests for information' / 'demandes d'informations' n'apparait nulle part dans le 10-Q T2 2026 (0 occurrence). Ecrire : 'Le 10-Q T2 2026 evoque des investigations menees par des regulateurs d'Etat en lien avec l'incident de cybersecurite de septembre 2023.' Preciser aussi que la mention figure dans la liste d'avertissements sur les declarations prospectives, pas dans une note de litiges.

controles.affirmation: Les indemnisations d'assurance pour interruption d'activite liees a cet incident continuent de baisser, a 8 M$ au T2 2026 contre 56 M$ un an plus tot
controles.verbatim_source: Operating income increased 2% for the six months ended June 30, 2026 ... due to the receipt of $56 million of business interruption insurance proceeds related to the September 2023 cybersecurity issue in the prior year period compared to $8 million in the current year period
controles.correction_proposee: Ces montants sont des cumuls SIX MOIS (S1 2026 vs S1 2025), pas des trimestres. Le 10-Q ne publie aucun chiffre trimestriel pour ce poste. Ecrire : '8 M$ sur le premier semestre 2026 contre 56 M$ sur le premier semestre 2025'.

controles.affirmation: 173,6 M$ rachetes au T2 2026 (source citee : 10-Q T2 2026)
controles.verbatim_source: During the three months ended June 30, 2026, the Company repurchased approximately 4 million shares of its common stock for an aggregate amount of $164 million
controles.correction_proposee: Le 10-Q chiffre les rachats du T2 2026 a 164 M$. Le 173,6 M$ provient de la ligne de flux de tresorerie (kpis-haut). Ne pas attribuer 173,6 M$ au 10-Q : soit ecrire '164 M$ (10-Q, Note 10)', soit '173,6 M$ decaisses (tableau de flux)'.

controles.affirmation: Loyer triple net de 552 M$ au T2 2026 et 1 117 M$ sur six mois ; passif de location operationnelle 23,78 Mds$ ; capitaux propres part du groupe 2,51 Mds$
controles.verbatim_source: Includes triple net lease rent expense of $552 million and $564 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025 ... and $1.1 billion for each of the six months ; Operating lease liabilities 23,778,515 ; Total MGM Resorts International stockholders' equity 2,513,775
controles.correction_proposee: Le chiffre exact 1 117 M$ n'est pas verbatim dans le 10-Q, qui indique '$1.1 billion'. Coherent mais reconstitue.

controles.affirmation: MGM Digital : EBITDAR ajuste de -30,9 M$ au T2 2026 contre -25,7 M$ (+20% de perte) ; depreciation de goodwill de 111 M$ sur une unite du segment
controles.verbatim_source: MGM Digital (30,884) (25,698) ; the Company recorded a goodwill impairment charge of $111 million relating to a reporting unit within the MGM Digital reportable segment

controles.affirmation: Resultat net part du groupe 292,4 M$ vs 49,0 M$ (+497%) ; gain de 287 M$ sur cessions dont 255 M$ MGM Northfield Park ; EBITDA ajuste consolide 610,4 M$ vs 647,5 M$ (-5,7%)
controles.verbatim_source: Net income attributable to MGM Resorts International 292,433 48,951 ; Operating income increased 24% ... due primarily to a $287 million gain in Property transactions, net for the current quarter, of which $255 million related to the gain on sale of the operations of MGM Northfield Park ; Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA $610,387 $647,514
controles.correction_proposee: Deux defauts de forme : (a) la preuve introduit la citation par 'Revenue for the three months ended...' alors que la phrase source commence par 'Operating income increased 24%...' ; (b) la formulation FR 'recule de 610,4 M$ a 647,5 M$ l'an dernier' inverse le sens de lecture.

controles.affirmation: MGM Osaka : participation d'environ 39 a 40%, engagement de 428 Mds de yens dont 335,9 Mds (env. 2,1 Mds$) restant a verser, garantie non plafonnee d'achevement
controles.verbatim_source: the Company also has a 39 % ownership interest in MGM Osaka Corporation ... in July 2026, the Company's ownership interest in MGM Osaka increased to approximately 40 % ; the Company has commitments to fund MGM Osaka of JPY 428 billion, of which an estimated amount of approximately JPY 335.9 billion (approximately $ 2.1 billion as of June 30, 2026 ) remains to be funded ; (2) of an uncapped amount to provide funding to MGM Osaka, if necessary, for the completion of the construction and full opening of the integrated resort

controles.affirmation: Pouvoir du gouvernement de Macao sur la concession de MGM Grand Paradise (resiliation sans indemnite, rachat des la 8e annee, refus de prolongation)
controles.verbatim_source: the ability of the Macau government to (i) terminate MGM Grand Paradise's concession under certain circumstances without compensating MGM Grand Paradise, (ii) from the eighth year of MGM Grand Paradise's concession, redeem the concession by providing MGM Grand Paradise at least one year's prior notice and subject to the payment of reasonable and fair damages or indemnity to MGM Grand Paradise, or (iii) refuse to grant MGM Grand Paradise an extension of the concession prior to its expiry
controles.correction_proposee: Passage present a l'identique dans le 10-Q T2 2026 (liste des declarations prospectives), pas seulement dans le 10-K FY2025.
